name: iPayX
description: Finance and Fintech: FINTRAC-registered Canadian FX forensic audit platform (iPayX Protocol) that scores foreign-exchange transactions against live mid-market rates via REST API and a native MCP server.
access_notes: Self-serve signup; free tier includes 5 lifetime audits and a no-signup public sandbox. Sustained API usage is paid (Developer $99/mo for 100 audits/mo up to Enterprise). API auth is a production API key passed as 'Authorization: Bearer ipx_live_...'; some MCP tools (rate check, limited audits) work without a key.
mcp_notes: Vendor-hosted MCP server at https://mcp.ipayx.ai/mcp (SSE/streamable HTTP, listed on the MCP Registry per vendor site) plus vendor-published GitHub/npm package @ipayx/mcp-fx-audit. No iPayX toolkit found in the Composio toolkits index.
uncertainty_notes: Young product with docs on the marketing site: ipayx.ai/docs returns 404 while ipayx.ai/developers hosts the API reference; the documented API base URL is currently a Supabase Functions URL (custom domain 'coming soon'). API surface is a single domain (FX audit: POST /v1/audit plus score-config CRUD), hence 'narrow'. Company verified as iPayX Protocol Inc. (11850091 Canada Inc., FINTRAC MSB C10001283).

evidence.note: Official developer docs: 'Authorization: Bearer ipx_live_your_key', REST endpoints (POST /v1/audit, /v1/score-config), webhooks (audit.completed, alert.triggered), pricing tiers Developer $99/mo to Enterprise, sandbox available.
Vendor MCP server URL https://mcp.ipayx.ai/mcp with tools check_fx_rate, audit_transaction, full_forensic_report; 'Officially listed on the MCP Registry (v1.3.3)'.
Homepage: free audit with no signup, 'Five free audits. Then transparent usage-based pricing'; FINTRAC MSB C10001283; REST API + SDKs + MCP + test sandbox sections.
Vendor GitHub org iPAYX-Technologies publishes the MCP server; README links ipayx.ai and app.ipayx.ai dashboards.
